description: Source code for importing and deserializing mobile PyTorch modules, including functions for reading bytecode, handling type resolution, object loading, and module deserialization.

classes.name: BytecodeDeserializer
classes.description: Class responsible for deserializing bytecode modules from stream or archive.

methods.name: resolveTypeName
methods.description: Resolves a type name to a TypePtr, handling special prefixes for class types.

methods.name: typeResolverMobile
methods.description: Creates a StrongTypePtr for a given qualified name.

methods.name: objLoaderMobile
methods.description: Loads an object of a given type from an IValue, handling custom classes and attributes.

methods.name: isTensorInBytecodeArchive
methods.description: Checks if the bytecode archive contains tensor data.

methods.description: Resolves a type name using resolveTypeNameMobile.

methods.name: BytecodeDeserializer::parseFunctionSchema
methods.description: Parses function schema from schema table.

methods.description: Initializes upgrader functions for a given function.

methods.description: Parses methods from bytecode and registers them.
